card.name: Digit ending CYP enzyme names
card.fires_on: The final digit in cytochrome P450 enzyme names, mostly the 6 in CYP2D6 and the 4 in CYP3A4. It appears in drug interaction and metabolism text.

modes.label: CYP2D6 digit
modes.description: The 6 closing CYP2D6 in metabolizer status, inhibition and substrate text.

modes.label: CYP3A4 digit
modes.description: The 4 closing CYP3A4 when inducers or substrates are discussed.
